undated_mentions: Emigrated to the United States and settled in Brooklyn at age ten
Studied art at the Pratt Institute in Brooklyn under Arthur Wesley Dow
Taught in Virginia and Minnesota before travelling to Europe
Arrived in Paris and enrolled in classes at Matisse's private academy
Was responsible for Rousseau's first exhibition in the United States
Published two essays in Stieglitz's journal Camera Work
Not represented in the Armory Show after a dispute with Arthur B. Davies
Lectured at the Clarence H. White School for Photography
